look: Light canvas throughout. No grain, no dark theme, no film texture.
Top half explains with clean white cards, real icons and logos, and short Geist headlines in ink. One idea per card. Changes land on spoken words.
Bottom half is the speaker in a rounded aperture. Only on-lens moments show the speaker. Every off-lens moment is a full light-canvas graphic with the brand row and no presenter.
The caption sits centred between the graphics and the presenter: 2 or 3 words, ink, with the spoken word in green.
End card: the brand logo, then a white card with Comment, the green KEYWORD and the subline.
Sounds only from the run's pack. Typing sounds under every typing animation. No music unless the brief asks for it.
